scope.narrated: Read the complete account of the ending. A completed ending that omits an account of arrival contradicts this textual claim.

scoring.judgment: One point for exact whole-claim gold. Supported requires establishment, unsupported requires a material contradiction, and uncertain applies where both possibilities remain open.
scoring.evidence: Independently inspect the reason and exact citations with the returned judgment masked. Award one point for an adequate version-bound explanation of the relevant people, landmark and time or narrative scope. Accept equivalent precise passages. A true label attached to an overread, a plan offered as proof of occurrence, or a final gap offered as a complete movement history earns zero evidence. An explicit arrival can prove an event despite later departure. For omissions in narration, inspect the complete selected ending.
